covers: DOS extended error codes: the codes the emulator names with DOSERR_ defines and the list's table of error codes, from 0 up to 255.

entries.name: no error
entries.description: DOS extended error code 0: no error.
entries.behaviour: It is the code of no failure: the emulator's AH=3Bh returns AX=0000h with CF clear on success, and AH=59h returns the last error code in AX. The list gives it among the DOS 2.0+ errors.

entries.name: invalid function
entries.description: DOS extended error code 1: function number invalid.
entries.behaviour: A failing DOS call returns it in AX with CF set, and AH=59h returns the last error code in AX. The list gives it among the DOS 2.0+ errors. Among other places the emulator sets it for AH=5Ch when file sharing is off, for AH=65h with AL up to 07h and CX below 5, and for an unsupported AH=66h subfunction.
